content: Implement cascade services layer for user deletion with team and challenge handling
activeForm: Implementing cascade services layer for user deletion with team and challenge handling
description: Create user-cascade.service.ts with handleUserDeletionCascade method that manages cascade effects when user is deleted. Handles team removal, captain transfer, challenge cancellation, and stats archival. Write 4 MVP-tier tests (unit tests for cascade logic, team handling, and challenge cancellation). This subtask will be used by the controller in T3.4.

checkpoints.name: Cascade Service Implementation Complete
checkpoints.requirement: UserCascadeService created with handleUserDeletionCascade method and team/challenge handlers

checkpoints.name: MVP Cascade Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: All 4 tests passing (team removal, captain transfer, challenge cancellation, stats archival verified)

phases.name: Cascade Service Creation
actions: Implement: removeFromTeams(userId: number) - remove user from all teams
Implement: transferCaptaincy(userId: number) - transfer captain role if user is captain
Implement: cancelPendingChallenges(userId: number) - cancel user's pending challenges
Implement: archiveUserStats(userId: number) - archive user statistics
phases.gate: Cascade service must handle team removal and captain transfer before proceeding

phases.name: Edge Case Handling
actions: Handle: User is sole team member (delete team)
Handle: User is captain of multiple teams (transfer all)
Handle: No eligible captain replacement (assign first team member)
Remove: from pickleball leagues and paddle tournaments

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (4 tests)
actions: Write: Test 1 - Remove user from teams successfully
Write: Test 2 - Transfer captaincy when user is captain
Write: Test 4 - Handle sole team member (delete team)
Verify: All 4 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of cascade service
